parrafo.es: Boards by Jaybee diseña y arma tablas de charcutería, mesas de grazing y cajas personalizadas para bodas, cumpleaños, baby showers y eventos corporativos en Westchester. También ofrecemos talleres de charcutería para aprender a armar tu propia tabla.
parrafo.en: Boards by Jaybee builds charcuterie boards, grazing tables and custom occasion boxes for weddings, birthdays, baby showers and corporate events around Westchester. We also run hands-on charcuterie workshops where you build your own board.

hero.imagen_alt: Personal charcuterie brunch board with waffles, pancakes, cheese and fruit by Boards by Jaybee

parrafo_1.es: Boards by Jaybee es un estudio de charcutería casero en Westchester, FL, construido sobre una idea simple: cada tabla debe verse tan bien como sabe. Desde tablas personales hasta mesas de grazing completas, cada montaje se arma a mano para la ocasión.
parrafo_1.en: Boards by Jaybee is a home-based charcuterie studio in Westchester, FL built around one simple idea: every board should look as good as it tastes. From personal boards to full grazing tables, each spread is arranged by hand for the occasion.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes regresan para cumpleaños, baby showers, días festivos y eventos corporativos, y también por los talleres de charcutería donde Judy enseña a grupos pequeños a armar su propia tabla, con snack incluido.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep coming back for birthdays, baby showers, holidays and corporate events, and for the hands-on charcuterie workshops where Judy teaches small groups to build their own board, snack included.

items.quote: Boards by Jaybee went above and beyond for my daughter's first birthday with a beautiful and delicious customized charcuterie cart. They were flexible, highly responsive and punctual. The cart was a big hit with all my guests (highly recommend adding on the guava jelly!). Great prices and phenomenal service! Will definitely be back.

I am beyond satisfied with the service provided by Boards by Jaybee. I have used her services for several of my gatherings, and each time I am impressed even more by how detailed and excellent her boards are. The quality of each of the meats and cheeses is delicious! She connects with you to ensure she adds the items you like, making you feel a part of the process. I highly recommend Boards by Jaybee for all events!!!

Attended a charcuterie workshop with Judy. Everything was setup so beautifully. The space was warm and inviting. She communicated days before the event and after the event was over. Her workshop was very thought out and she explained everything perfectly as we were following along. Her choice of cheeses, meats and fruits were a great choice and perfect for the season. Overall, great experience by Judy. I would attend again.
